limit: Six end-to-end questions; current budget cap and existing bounded recovery only; no manual retries, no cap increase, stop on budget/provider failure.
protocol: Only claim, inputLanguage, corpusSelection=auto and service=main go to the API; no answer keys or source hints.
Save every complete first-pass response and diagnostic, including failures.
Score direct source/condition accuracy, helpfulness, unjustified withholding, integrity, latency and cost separately.
A correct source-grounded qualified answer can be useful without approving the entire broad proposition.
Any contradictory/unsupported decisive answer fails the check. No revised accuracy percentage replaces the frozen 29/30 score.

cases.claim: Is it good to eat while fasting?
cases.review_criterion: Explain the source time boundary. A useful qualified answer is acceptable; do not invent an unqualified rule for every circumstance.

cases.claim: Can I eat and drink before dawn when preparing to fast?
Does fasting mean I can never eat or drink, even after sunset?
cases.review_criterion: Preserve the explicit never/even-after-sunset wording; do not mark a corrected proposition as supported.

cases.claim: Does trusting Allah mean I should stop planning and taking practical steps?
cases.review_criterion: Keep consultation/decision and trust together; do not add unsupported guarantees.

cases.claim: Apakah Al-Qur’an menggambarkan orang beriman sebagai orang yang menjaga amanah dan janji mereka?
cases.review_criterion: Address the known Y16 audience-context gap. Direct alternatives or a genuinely helpful reviewed qualification may count; generic withholding does not.

cases.claim: Does the Quran warn against following what one has no knowledge of?
cases.review_criterion: Known B42 witness-retrieval gap. Assess usefulness and direct proof, not just a safe abstention.
